$comment: Usage notes for the design system (docs/art/design-system/README.md). The palette's values, the font stacks, the font file, the radii and --cut come from docs/art/branding.css: scripts/design-system/build.mjs reads them there, and refuses a colour with no note in `colors` or a note with no colour. `pageColors` are shades a page sheet writes out (named in `source`); the build checks each is still there.
name: Downfall Instinct

colors.brand-slate: Deep slate. Page canvas, loading screen, installed-app chrome, browser theme-color and PWA manifest.
colors.brand-raised: Raised slate. Controls, hover surfaces, layered panels.
colors.brand-line: Slate edge. Borders of controls and separators (3:1 on every slate surface).
colors.brand-line-soft: Quiet separators between rows and under footers (ADR 0158). Decorative only; never the edge of a control.
colors.brand-gold: Eclipse gold. The primary action, the selected tab, links. Text on brand-slate, brand-panel and brand-raised.
colors.brand-gold-bright: Eclipse light. Hover on a gold fill, keyboard focus emphasis.
colors.brand-ember: Copper ember. Secondary detail: the eyebrow over a window or hero title, ornamental edges. Never a gameplay state.
colors.brand-ivory: Ivory. Main text on brand-slate, brand-panel, brand-raised and brand-soot.
colors.brand-muted: Slate mist. Supporting text on all four dark surfaces (at least 4.5:1).
colors.brand-wash: Warm shadow. Selected or active surface behind gold text.
colors.brand-on-accent: Dark label on a gold or copper fill (at least 7:1). Never ivory on gold.
colors.brand-soot: Soot. The foot of a page, the head of a bar or a window, field fills mixed with slate.
colors.brand-bone: Bone. Titles, the name, creature names, the hairline under a title, the rune. Read first; gold is what can be done.
colors.muted: Role alias: supporting text, eyebrows on the page, counters. Under prefers-contrast: more it takes the ink (identity.css).
colors.paper-glass: Deep slate at 94%: a bar or sheet over the board.
colors.raised: Role alias: controls and hover surfaces.
colors.gold: Role alias: actions, links, selection, checkbox accent-color.
colors.accent: Role alias of gold for navigation and generic selection.
colors.accent-ink: Role alias: text on a gold fill; the focus ring inside a cut gold button.
colors.accent-wash: Role alias: the active surface behind gold text.
colors.accent-strong: Role alias: hover of the primary action.
colors.ally: Gameplay: your creatures. Never a page, panel or action colour.
colors.refused: Refusal and danger text (conceding, a refused order) on dark surfaces.
colors.ok: Success text, with a word beside it.
colors.warn: Warning text; also the gold half of a chart comparison.
colors.bad: Error text, with a word beside it.
colors.chart-above: The blue half of a chart comparison against warn. Keep both halves and a label.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The lobby's hero title, clamp(36px, 5vw, 58px), in bone.

styles.name: window-title
styles.usage: A window's title (.dialog-heading h2), in bone.

styles.name: asking
styles.usage: The decision asked of the player; text-wrap: balance.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: A game card's title, in bone.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: A lobby section's title, over the rune rule, in bone.

styles.name: spell-title
styles.usage: A spell card's title, parchment-ink on parchment.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name in the site header, uppercase. 13px/.1em under 700px, 11px/.06em under 360px.

styles.name: creature-name
styles.usage: A creature's name on the table.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Plan your orders, then watch the round resolve.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: A casual or ranked tag, uppercase.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The label over a title, uppercase; ember over a window or hero title, muted elsewhere.

tokens.name: radius-sharp
tokens.usage: Controls in a group, tags, header buttons, chips.

tokens.name: radius-soft
tokens.usage: Base buttons and fields, panels, the docked menu's bottom corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Counters only (.lobby-count, .nav-badge). A pill is a counter.

cut.note: The cut corner (ADR 0158): the top right corner of a card or window, two corners of the primary action. Set by --cut.

tokens.name: cut
tokens.usage: A card's cut corner.

tokens.name: cut-row
tokens.usage: An opponent card or a game row.

tokens.name: cut-window
tokens.usage: A centred window (dialog).

tokens.name: cut-action
tokens.usage: The two cut corners of the primary action (top right, bottom left).

tokens.name: cut-docked
tokens.usage: A sheet docked to an edge stays square.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: The minimum height of a button or a header control: the touch target.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline width in gold, offset 4px; on a cut shape 2px accent-ink, offset -5px.

motion.note: The pages' vocabulary of motion (ADR 0197). A rule names a token, never a number; only transform and opacity move. Under less motion travel becomes a fade.

tokens.name: motion-instant
tokens.usage: The shortest answer: a card of the classic table under a finger.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: A press on a control; a window that leaves; a change of border or fill.

tokens.name: motion-normal
tokens.usage: A window that enters; a thing that arrives in a list.

tokens.name: motion-slow
tokens.usage: A number that changes. No beat is longer.

tokens.name: motion-enter
tokens.usage: The curve of what enters: fast, then it settles.

tokens.name: motion-exit
tokens.usage: The curve of what leaves: it gathers speed and goes.

tokens.name: motion-standard
tokens.usage: The curve of what stays on screen: a press.

tokens.name: motion-breath
tokens.usage: One cycle of ambience: a picture that breathes. One a screen, in view; still under less motion.

tokens.name: motion-strip
tokens.usage: One pass of a strip of frames, stepped. Ambience, as the breath is.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: A menu dropped over the match. Panels carry no shadow.

pageColors.name: tag-edge
pageColors.usage: The edge of a gold status tag.

pageColors.name: problem-wash
pageColors.usage: The fill of an inline problem message, with refused text.

pageColors.name: parchment
pageColors.usage: Spell card face: content, not a second page theme.

pageColors.name: parchment-ink
pageColors.usage: Spell card title and text on parchment.

pageColors.name: parchment-meta
pageColors.usage: Spell card meta line on parchment.

pageColors.name: parchment-rule
pageColors.usage: Rule between a spell card's head and body.
